Why Africa has to be reconstructed
WITS carries no all-Africa aggregate; its MEA region mixes the Maghreb with the Gulf, so it
cannot stand in for North Africa. Africa must therefore be built as SSF plus Algeria, Egypt,
Libya, Morocco and Tunisia. Mauritania already sits inside SSF and is not added again.
Algeria and Libya file neither export nor import returns to Comtrade. Every flow they take
part in is nonetheless reported by the counterpart, so their intra-African trade is recovered
from the other side of each pair - $2.9bn in 2023. This is the standard mirror procedure.
Which measure to quote
The export basis gives 16.5% for all Africa and 20.9% for SSF. The averaged (X+M) measure,
which is the one normally cited in AfCFTA and UNCTAD work, gives 17.3% for SSF. The import
leg cannot be completed for all Africa, because Algeria's and Libya's own imports are absent
from both sides, so no all-Africa X+M figure is given here.
On the ordering
On every basis, Africa sits ABOVE Latin America (14.8%) and the Middle East and North Africa
(14.3%) on the averaged measure. Africa's intraregional trade is low, but it is not the
second lowest in the world, and South Asia (3.7%) is not the only region below it.
All figures are goods only. Services are not covered by this database.
